notes: Sidedoor 1.0.0: Sidedoor now signs in to employer sites for you, or creates the account and confirms it from your mailbox. When a site needs you, or shows a human check, a desktop alert tells you and a card under Needs you lets you do the step right there. One LinkedIn sign-in now covers contacts and outreach. Approvals can be filtered by label, and there is a new Metrics tab.
